skill.focus_note: Skill focus — do this first, fresh
skill.lore_note: These prerequisites are woven into your plan's primary day. Progress them before chasing the full skill.

lore.handstand: The freestanding handstand is a balance skill built on a pressing-strength base. It asks for profound shoulder flexion and wrist extension under load, an actively pushed 'open' scapula, and a rib-cage-tucked hollow line so corrections come from the fingertips, not the hips. Most of the work is nervous-system tuning: short, frequent exposures beat long grinding sets.
lore.muscle_up: The muscle-up is a pull-up that doesn't stop at the chin and a dip that starts below the bar. The bottleneck is the transition: rotating the wrists over the bar while the elbows travel from behind you to under you. It needs an explosive pull to sternum height, a secure false grip, and straight-bar dip strength to finish the rep.
lore.pistol_squat: The pistol squat is a full-depth single-leg squat with the free leg held out front. It demands deep ankle dorsiflexion, single-leg balance, and enough anterior-core and hip-flexor strength to keep the extended leg up. Hamstring and adductor tissue tolerance at end range is the usual limiter.
lore.planche: The planche holds the body parallel to the ground on straight arms — the hardest straight-arm push skill. It loads the wrists heavily and requires a strongly protracted, depressed scapula and a forward lean deep enough to put the shoulders well past the hands. Progress is measured in degrees of lean and seconds of hold.
lore.front_lever: The front lever is a straight-arm horizontal hang facing up. It's a scapular-depression and lat-strength benchmark paired with brutal anterior-core anti-extension: the lats pull the straight arms down toward the hips while the trunk resists folding. Lever length is the difficulty dial — tuck, then straddle, then full.
lore.human_flag: The human flag holds the body sideways on a vertical pole: the top arm presses down, the bottom arm pulls up, and the obliques and QL fight gravity's rotation. It blends overhead pressing strength, lat pulling strength, and lateral-core endurance in one static hold.
lore.dragon_flag: The dragon flag keeps the whole body rigid and straight while it lowers from vertical, pivoting only at the shoulder blades. It's an anterior-core anti-extension drill under a long lever, with the lats and grip anchoring the torso to the bench. Slow eccentrics build it fastest.

blurb.handstand: Balance on your hands. Built on overhead pressing strength, wrist conditioning, and a tight hollow line.
blurb.muscle_up: Pull-up into a dip above the bar. Needs an explosive pull, a false-grip, and a clean transition.
blurb.pistol_squat: Full-depth single-leg squat. Demands ankle mobility, single-leg balance, and hip control.
blurb.planche: Hold your body parallel to the floor on straight arms. The hardest straight-arm push skill.
blurb.front_lever: Hang horizontal on straight arms, facing up. A straight-arm pull and anterior-core benchmark.
blurb.human_flag: Hold your body horizontal on a vertical pole. Top arm presses, bottom arm pulls, obliques hold the line.
blurb.dragon_flag: Lower a rigid, straight body from vertical, pivoting only at the shoulders. A long-lever core benchmark.

step_hint.wall_walk: Feet on the wall, walk your hands in until vertical, then walk out.
step_hint.shoulder_taps: From a tall plank, tap each shoulder without letting the hips rock.
step_hint.pike_push_up: Hips high, lower the crown of your head toward your hands.
step_hint.chest_to_wall_hold: Face the wall, belly and chest touching, hold a straight line.
step_hint.decline_push_up: Feet elevated so more weight shifts onto the shoulders.
step_hint.hollow_hold: Lower back pressed flat, arms and legs extended off the floor.
step_hint.freestanding_balance: Kick up away from the wall and fight for the balance point.
step_hint.australian_row: Bar at hip height, pull the chest to the bar with a straight body.
step_hint.explosive_pull_up: Pull as high and fast as you can — aim for the sternum.
step_hint.chest_to_bar: Every rep touches the bar to the top of the chest.
step_hint.straight_bar_dip: Lean forward over a straight bar, lower until the shoulders drop below the elbows.
step_hint.transition_negative: From the top of the bar, lower slowly through the transition.
step_hint.full_muscle_up: Explosive pull, roll the wrists over the bar, press to lockout.
step_hint.bodyweight_squat: Full depth, knees tracking over the toes, chest tall.
step_hint.box_squat: Sit to a low box on one leg, stand without rocking.
step_hint.split_squat: Long stance, drop the back knee straight down, drive through the front heel.
step_hint.assisted_pistol: Hold a post or rings for balance while you sit to full depth.
step_hint.shrimp_squat: Hold the rear foot behind you, lower until the back knee taps.
step_hint.nordic_curl: Anchor the ankles, lower as slowly as you can, catch and push back.
step_hint.full_pistol: One leg straight out front, sit all the way down and stand under control.
step_hint.planche_lean: Tall plank, shift the shoulders forward past the hands and hold.
step_hint.l_sit: Press down hard, lift the hips, legs straight and parallel to the floor.
step_hint.tuck_planche_hold: Knees tucked to the chest, hips level with the shoulders, arms straight.
step_hint.advanced_tuck_planche: Open the hips so the back rounds less and the knees drop.
step_hint.straddle_planche: Legs wide and straight, body parallel to the floor.
step_hint.hanging_knee_raise: Dead hang, curl the knees to the chest, lower with no swing.
step_hint.tuck_front_lever: Hang, tuck the knees, pull the back parallel to the floor, arms straight.
step_hint.advanced_tuck_front_lever: Extend the hips so the torso lengthens while the knees stay bent.
step_hint.straight_arm_pull_down: Standing or hanging, pull a band or bar down with locked elbows.
step_hint.single_leg_front_lever: One leg extended, one tucked, hold the horizontal line.
step_hint.straddle_front_lever: Legs wide and straight, full body horizontal and facing up.
step_hint.pull_up: Dead hang, pull the elbows to the ribs, clear the bar with the chin.
step_hint.vertical_flag_pull: Grip a vertical pole high and low, pull yourself in to a vertical support.
step_hint.support_flag_hold: From the vertical support, let the hips drift out a few degrees and hold.
step_hint.tuck_flag: Knees tucked to the chest, body horizontal on the pole, press and pull hard.
step_hint.straddle_flag: Legs wide and straight, body horizontal — shorten the lever from full.
step_hint.dragon_negative: From a shoulder-stand on the bench, lower the straight body as slowly as possible.
step_hint.tuck_dragon_flag: Knees bent, lower and raise the hips while only the shoulders touch the bench.
step_hint.straddle_dragon_flag: Legs wide and straight, control the full range without piking.
step_hint.full_dragon_flag: Whole body rigid and straight, lower under control, pivot only at the shoulders.

push_up.0: Hands under the shoulders, body in one line
push_up.2: Push the floor away; don't flare the elbows

incline_push_up.0: Hands on a bench or rail
incline_push_up.2: The higher the surface, the easier the rep

pike_push_up.0: Hips high, head pointing at the floor
pike_push_up.1: Lower the crown of your head toward your hands
pike_push_up.2: Press back up to the pike position

dip.0: Start at lockout with the shoulders pulled down
dip.1: Lower until the shoulders drop below the elbows
dip.2: Lean forward for chest, stay upright for triceps

pseudo_planche_push_up.0: Hands by your waist, fingers pointing back
pseudo_planche_push_up.1: Lean forward so the shoulders pass the hands
pseudo_planche_push_up.2: Hold the lean through the whole rep

decline_push_up.0: Feet elevated on a box or chair
decline_push_up.1: More weight on the hands — expect fewer reps
decline_push_up.2: Keep the body straight; don't pike at the hips

australian_row.0: Bar or rings set at hip height
australian_row.1: Pull the chest to the bar and squeeze the shoulder blades
australian_row.2: The straighter your body, the harder it is

pull_up.0: Start from a dead hang, palms facing away
pull_up.1: Pull the elbows down toward your ribs
pull_up.2: Clear the bar with your chin, then lower under control

chin_up.1: Drive the elbows down and back
chin_up.2: Return to a full hang every rep

archer_pull_up.0: Pull toward one hand while the other arm stays straight
archer_pull_up.1: Keep the working elbow tight to the ribs

bodyweight_squat.0: Feet shoulder-width, toes turned out slightly
bodyweight_squat.1: Sit back and down; knees track over the toes
bodyweight_squat.2: Stand tall and squeeze the glutes at the top

split_squat.1: Drop the back knee straight down
split_squat.2: Drive up through the front heel

shrimp_squat.0: Hold the rear foot behind you
shrimp_squat.1: Lower until the back knee taps the floor

pistol_squat.0: One leg held straight out in front
pistol_squat.1: Sit all the way down under control
pistol_squat.2: Push through the whole foot to stand

nordic_curl.0: Anchor the ankles; body straight from the knees
nordic_curl.1: Lower as slowly as you can
nordic_curl.2: Catch with the hands and push back up

plank.1: Squeeze the glutes and brace the abs
plank.2: One straight line from head to heels

hollow_hold.0: Press the lower back into the floor
hollow_hold.1: Arms and legs extended, shoulders off the mat
hollow_hold.2: Lower the limbs to make it harder

hanging_knee_raise.1: Curl the knees up to the chest

l_sit.0: Press down hard on the floor or parallettes
l_sit.1: Legs straight and together, toes pointed
l_sit.2: Lift the hips so the legs clear the ground

front_lever_tuck.0: Hang and pull the bar toward your hips
front_lever_tuck.1: Tuck the knees; back parallel to the floor
